an7.95:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] sattime bhikkhave, puggalā āhuneyyā pāhuneyyā dakkhiṇeyyā añjalikaraṇīyā anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa.
an7.95:1.3: idha bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo cakkhusmiṃ aniccānupassī viharati, aniccasaññī aniccapaṭisaṃvedī satataṃ samitaṃ abbokiṇṇaṃ cetasā adhimuccamāno paññāya pariyogāhamāno.
an7.95:1.4: so āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
an7.95:1.5: ayaṃ kho bhikkhave, paṭhamo puggalo āhuneyyā …pe… anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa.
an7.95:2.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave ekacco puggalo cakkhusmiṃ aniccānupassī viharati, aniccasaññī aniccapaṭisaṃvedī satataṃ samitaṃ abbokiṇṇaṃ cetasā adhimuccamāno paññāya pariyogāhamāno.
an7.95:2.2: tassa apubbaṃ acarimaṃ āsavapariyādānañca hoti jīvitapariyādānañca.
an7.95:2.3: ayaṃ bhikkhave, dutiyo puggalo āhuneyyo …pe… anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa.
an7.95:3.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, idhekacco puggalo cakkhusmiṃ aniccānupassī viharati aniccasaññī aniccapaṭisaṃvedī satataṃ samitaṃ abbokkiṇṇaṃ cetasā adhimuccamāno paññāya pariyogāhamāno.
an7.95:3.2: so pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā antarāparinibbāyī hoti. ayaṃ bhikkhave, tatiyo puggalo āhuneyyo …pe… anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa. …pe…
an7.95:3.3: upahaccaparinibbāyī hoti. ayaṃ bhikkhave, catuttho puggalo āhuneyyo …pe…
an7.95:3.5: asaṃkhāraparinibbāyī hoti. ayaṃ bhikkhave, pañcamo puggalo āhuneyyo …pe… anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa. …pe… sasaṃkhāra parinibbāyī hoti. ayaṃ bhikkhave, chaṭṭho puggalo āhuneyyo …pe… anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa. …pe…
an7.95:3.7: ayaṃ bhikkhave, sattamo puggalo āhuneyyo …pe… anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa.
an7.95:3.8: ime kho bhikkhave, satta puggalā āhuneyyā pāhuneyyā dakkhiṇeyyā añjalikaraṇīyā anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassāti.
